# A Major

A Major is a software company for the agent era, based in Singapore. Our flagship product is Ryu.

**Website:** https://amajor.ai
**Email:** contact@amajor.ai
**Location:** Singapore

---

## Ryu

> A managed platform for AI agents.

Ryu is a managed platform for AI agents, built on open-source infrastructure. Start without building from scratch, add tools with plugins, and turn your agents into apps. Monitor every run and control what your agents can access.

- Start without building from scratch
- Add tools with plugins
- Turn your agents into apps
- Monitor every run
- Control what your agents can access

- **Status:** Research Preview
- **Product page:** https://amajor.ai/products/ryu
- **Homepage:** https://ryuhq.com

---

## Products

> Most AI agents didn't deliver. We build the ones that do.

Industry research puts real enterprise value from AI agents under 10%. A Major builds the platform that makes delivering real value repeatable — starting with Ryu.

### Backstage

The open-source YouTube thumbnail studio. A free, cross-platform desktop app for designing YouTube thumbnails, with layer-based editing, AI background removal, video frame extraction, and AI image generation running locally.

- **Product page:** https://amajor.ai/products/backstage
- **Source:** https://github.com/amajorai/backstage
